LSO.note: SIM registration rules cited for consumer protection against crime, not digital financial services conduct rules.
The asylum-seeker certificate is validated with the Commissioner of Refugees, not checked against a national ID.

facts.fact: The National Assembly portfolio committee allowed the 2024 SIM Registration Amendment Regulations, which create a registration category letting asylum seekers register SIM cards on their asylum-seeker certificate, validated with the Commissioner of Refugees, and noted the registration allows mobile financial transactions.
